bonusExpiry.mechanism: expireStaleBonuses() sweeps user_bonuses where expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
bonusExpiry.walletEffect: Reduces wallets.bonus_balance by expired active bonus amount

freebetExpiry.mechanism: deposit_freebet_grants expires_at check in tryGrantDepositFreebet and bet placement validation
freebetExpiry.walletEffect: Remaining unspent grant is marked EXPIRED

dailySpinExpiry.mechanism: expireSpinGrants() called on-demand before every wallet snapshot / daily spin check
dailySpinExpiry.walletEffect: Unused spin grant balance deducted from bonus_balance or freebet_balance

audit.historicalPreservation: Expired records remain preserved in database with status='EXPIRED'
